about: Corrective bones the remake's own animation system drives and a posed mesh leaves stiff. Each row turns 'bone' (component space) by 'share' of the way from how far 'from' has turned since rest to how far 'to' has (0 = with from, 1 = with to). Shoulder fixups at half keep the top of the arm from collapsing when the arm hangs down from the remake's bind pose.
